plain: A person who receives regular payment for past service

webster.text: One to whom an annual sum of money is paid by government in consideration of past services.

more.text: One who receives an annual allowance for services.

example.quote: There were thirty thousand stand of arms, nearly, in his power, which were defended by a pensioner of this country.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
